paragraphs.text: Wydwen , the Biting Gale , was a mysterious legendary faerie character from Lorwyn-Shadowmoor .
Wydwen appears as a blue-skinned female faerie with red hair, dragonfly-like wings, and wearing a black dress. Little is known about her beyond the following description:
It was also said that in a world of bright, cloudless skies, she is the dark storm on the horizon.
